(1) THE DANGER POINT GATE: 135 of 162 rows carry bracket.valid false, so C24 - the one principle I enforce exactly as written, 'a setup without an identifiable danger point is not a setup' - rejected 83% of the field before any Wyckoff reading began; 34 names failed ONLY that gate. I will not pad a list when the safety test that stops me being the bag-holder cannot be executed. (3) THE TURNING POINT IS STILL UNSERVED: no range boundary, no penetration event, so the 30% dimension has zero detection. Filing few names is the expected output of this seat until a levels engine ships. Padding to ten from composite scores would be the breach, not the shortfall.

declared.volume_profile: NOT_SERVED, not NOT_COMPUTABLE - C25, R11. The value area (VAL to VAH, 68.2% of traded volume), the VPOC and high/low volume nodes are the volume-at-price layer, and the trading-range principle - price rejects at the extremes BECAUSE value keeps generating near the centre - follows mechanically from them. The Energy engine already computes vp_position_score from a real volume profile at every run and throws it away at the composite-score stage. This is an engine-EXPOSURE ask, not a new build, and it is the cheapest unlock in this canon.
